scm.noise: independent N(0,1) for every row and node

rng_rule: default_rng(seed+100000*n); independent draws per sample size, no nested reuse
skeleton: PC-stable adjacency search: freeze all adjacency sets at each conditioning depth, evaluate both endpoints' neighbor sets; collect all minimum-depth accepted separators before simultaneous deletion
colliders: conservative unshielded collider orientation: middle absent from every stored minimum-depth separator; opposite requests reported as conflict, not forced
orientation_limit: no Meek closure; not a complete PC-stable CPDAG implementation
background: only node time tiers; orient surviving different-tier skeleton edges forward, report separately from collider directions; never supply true edges to learner
ci: sample covariance partial correlation from inverse covariance; Fisher-z approximate two-sided p; p>alpha removes edge; covariance oracle uses abs(partial r)<1e-10
controls: 3-node chain/fork covariance Markov-equivalence counterexample, v-structure collider; oracle d-separation independently checked by ancestral moral graph on all pairs/subsets
metrics: collider-direction precision recall w.r.t. actual DAG edges
finite CI errors versus population conditional independence
evaluation: persist learned outputs before evaluator loads true graph; no method/alpha tuning, no ML hyperparameters; graph truth module separate from learner
budget: 40 finite datasets, five node orders each; 120 oracle orders; five nodes only, CPU; no new dependencies
raw_root: data/驱动因素解耦模拟数据集_B1_graph_v1_20261021
limits: not real EV graph or mixed/nonlinear graph discovery
time direction is prior information not learned evidence
Fisher-z finite-sample approximation, multiple adaptive CI tests not familywise alpha guarantee
single structural mechanism, no generalization or 103 acceptance claim
